question: According to the ML model, which input features matter most for the PCE of p-i-n perovskite solar cells? List the top five.
final_answer:
According to the `model_PIN.cbm` CatBoost PCE model for p-i-n (inverted) cells (global SHAP, PIN subset, 96 designs), the top five features are:

| Rank | Feature | Importance | Direction |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 1 | Perovskite | 0.2818 | Negative |
| 2 | HTL_deposition_method | 0.2144 | Negative |
| 3 | Substrate_stack_sequence | 0.1957 | Positive |
| 4 | Backcontact_stack_sequence | 0.1674 | Negative (near-zero mean; sign varies across designs) |
| 5 | Perovskite_deposition_solvents | 0.1286 | Positive |

Perovskite identity is the most influential input, followed by HTL deposition method and substrate stack sequence. These are global SHAP associations, not causal effects (validation on unseen papers: RMSE 3.98, R² 0.38), and the report does not identify which specific categorical levels drive each effect.
